Method of Attack: Conceals malware in 'travis.yml' file disguised as a macOS binary named 'Safari updates'
Drops a Mach-O binary disguised as 'updateSafari' in '~/Library/Application Support/Safari Update'
Executes malicious binary using 'nohup' to persist after shell termination
Deletes 'package-lock.js' or overwrites 'package.json' to remove traces
Connects to a remote URL to retrieve a stage 2 payload
Discoverer: Sonatype security researchers Carlos Fernández, Raphael Luy, Sebastian Arias Amador
Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages installed via npm registry
Execution triggered by 'preinstall' script running 'package-lock.js' after package installation
Indicators of Compromise: Use of 'nohup' command to run binary persistently
Deletion or overwriting of 'package-lock.js' or 'package.json' to hide traces
Domain 'passgenwizard[.]com' registered on 17th July via Namecheap, hosted on Windows IIS
